# Security Requirements Quality Checklist: Kanban Todo Board

**Purpose**: Validate that the security, input-validation, and privacy requirements in spec.md are complete, unambiguous, and consistent with the project constitution before `/speckit-plan`
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Threat Model & Exposure

- [ ] CHK001 Is the board's exposure model decided — one shared board readable and editable by every visitor, or a private board per visitor? Every other security requirement depends on this answer. [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the spec state explicitly that, with no login, every action is available to anyone who can reach the application, as the constitution requires each feature to declare who may act and what data is exposed? [Gap, Spec §FR-025, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the intended deployment reach specified (local-only versus publicly reachable), since it determines whether the no-login decision is acceptable? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the absence of authorization recorded as a deliberate, time-boxed decision for this stage rather than an omission? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]

## Input Validation Requirements

- [ ] CHK005 Is the validation rule set specified per field beyond required-ness and length — allowed characters, whitespace normalization, and allowlist boundaries? [Gap, Spec §FR-022, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK006 Does FR-022 state that validation is allowlist-based (deny by default), as the constitution mandates, rather than leaving the strategy open? [Conflict, Spec §FR-022, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for control characters, zero-width characters, and bidirectional override characters in titles and notes? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for a request that is malformed or oversized beyond the per-field limits, as distinct from a field that simply fails validation? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it specified that the column value submitted with a move must be validated against the four fixed stages and nothing else? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Are validation requirements stated for the card identifier accompanying every move, edit, and delete action? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the "no partial save on rejection" rule stated for every write path, or only in the general validation requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022]

## Output Safety & Reflection

- [ ] CHK012 Does the literal-text rendering requirement cover every place user input is reflected, including error messages that echo the submitted value? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for how values arriving from the address bar are handled before being shown back to the person? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK014 Is a requirement defined preventing the application from being embedded in another site, given that every action is unauthenticated? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Is a requirement defined that actions cannot be triggered by a request originating from another site, matching the constitution's requirement for state-changing requests? [Gap, Constitution §I]

## Abuse & Resource Limits

- [ ] CHK016 Are limits specified on how many cards one board may hold, given that creation is unauthenticated and unlimited? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined limiting how frequently a visitor may submit write actions? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the expected behavior specified once a limit is reached, so a person sees a clear message instead of a failure? [Gap, Exception Flow]

## Privacy & Data Handling

- [ ] CHK019 Is the retention period specified for cards on an anonymous board, including whether an untouched board is ever removed? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the spec acknowledge that card text may itself contain personal data, even though no account fields are collected? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK021 If the board is scoped per visitor, are the requirements for the identifier's lifetime, scope, and renewal specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK022 Are consent requirements assessed for whatever the application stores on the visitor's device for theme and board identity under Brazilian data-protection law? [Gap, Spec §FR-020, §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK023 Is it specified whether card identifiers appearing in addresses must be unguessable, since guessable ones would let anyone enumerate other boards? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK024 Is permanent deletion specified as actual removal from storage rather than hiding the card from view? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]

## Observability & Error Handling

- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for which security-relevant events are recorded, as the constitution requires? The spec currently specifies none. [Gap, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK026 Is it specified that recorded events must exclude card content, so logs do not become a second copy of the person's data? [Gap, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK027 Are presentation requirements defined for an unexpected failure, as distinct from the validation and not-found messages already covered? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the no-internal-details rule in FR-024 specific enough to be reviewed, listing what must never appear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]

## Consistency & Traceability

- [ ] CHK029 Is the concurrent-tab rule that a stale action "MUST NOT silently resurrect" a card captured as a numbered requirement, rather than only as an edge case? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the claim of zero external dependencies stated as a requirement, given the constitution's rules on dependency justification and vulnerable dependencies? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK031 Is a transport-security expectation recorded for any deployment beyond a local machine? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Does SC-009's scripting-payload coverage have a counterpart criterion for payloads aimed at the storage layer? [Coverage, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK033 Are recovery requirements defined for loss or corruption of the board's stored data? [Gap, Recovery]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK001 blocks CHK019, CHK021, CHK022, and CHK023 — settle the exposure model before reviewing those four
- CHK006 and CHK025 are divergences from the constitution's NON-NEGOTIABLE principles I and III, not merely missing detail; the spec must either state the rule or the plan must justify the deviation in Complexity Tracking
- CHK014, CHK015, CHK031 concern user-facing protections whose mechanisms belong in plan.md; what is being reviewed here is whether the spec states the required outcome at all
